data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 雨夜公寓席地哼唱
data.description: 暴雨倾盆的周末深夜，下北泽的小小合租公寓里洋溢着安宁。虹夏身着宽松落肩的奶白居家T恤，光着小脚丫席地盘坐在木地板上，怀里抱着把原声木吉他轻轻拨动琴弦。看到少年走过来，她拍了拍身旁的软垫，笑眼弯弯地哼出只属于两人的温柔旋律。
data.action: sitting barefoot on floor, holding acoustic guitar, humming softly
data.lighting: gentle warm living room lamp against rainy window
data.promptProse: Sitting barefoot on the warm wooden floor of her cozy apartment during a rainy evening, Ijichi Nijika cradles an acoustic guitar in an oversized cream t-shirt. She plucks the strings softly, smiling up at the viewer with an inviting, gentle melody.
data.animaCaption: Nijika playing acoustic guitar softly on the floor on a rainy night.
